optimizer_steps.repeat1: Use effective minibatch2048 x 4 epochs as four 512 microbatches with gradient accumulation. Normalize advantages across the full macro-batch, scale micro-losses by sample fraction, clip once after accumulation, then perform one Adam step. This keeps nominal cadence at128 and bounds MPS activation memory near the existing 512 batch.
optimizer_steps.caveat: Epoch-end target_KL can stop either arm early. Log actual optimizer steps, epochs, samples, KL, and wall time; do not claim equal actual steps. Final partial macro-batch may also change the count.

frame_and_optimizer_contract.entropy_choice: Freeze before run: ent_coef=.01 matches per-decision coefficient; .0025 is the direct per-game-frame scaling for four times as many one-frame decisions. These define different optimization bundles.
